gates.title: Julia manifest and environment reproducibility
gates.message: DiffMoM is a library package: .gitignore excludes Manifest.toml, Project.toml declares compatibility bounds, and the executable clean-resolution gate resolves and precompiles the package in an isolated environment. Exact manifest reproducibility is therefore not a repository contract.

Exact manifest reproducibility is therefore not a repository contract.

New exact-residual saturation tests use captured inputs and independent 4352-bit expectations. Python validation reports pass 23 tests on both Python 3.9 and 3.14. gates.title: Julia source, configuration, and secret security scan
gates.message: Gitleaks 8.30.1 was obtained from the current official release with its published SHA256 checked. The current history scan covered 581 commits and found no leaks. A working-tree scan produced four generic-api-key findings, all inspected as generated Documenter API heading fragment identifiers, not credentials. No new allowlist or suppression was added. See TEST_REPORT.md for the scan boundary and evidence; this is not a general vulnerability-free claim.

gates.title: Julia SBOM, licenses, and available advisories
gates.message: Generate an SBOM from the manifest when applicable, inspect package sources/licenses, and run an available Julia-aware advisory scanner. Record unavailable ecosystem coverage as UNVERIFIED.
gates.rationale: The repository has an MIT license and declared dependency compatibility bounds, but it commits no manifest and the audited environment has no JuliaHub CLI or other Julia-aware advisory scanner. No SBOM or advisory result is available, so this remains an explicit security boundary.

gates.title: ExplicitImports and public-name checks
gates.message: The current one/four-thread test graph passed its ExplicitImports checks. The new proper-complex sampling code uses Base.randn, its checked canonical owner, rather than Random.randn. The existing exact non-public-name allowlist and stale/implicit/owner checks were retained. See TEST_REPORT.md.
gates.evidence: The current one/four-thread test graph passed its ExplicitImports checks. The new proper-complex sampling code uses Base.randn, its checked canonical owner, rather than Random.randn. The existing exact non-public-name allowlist and stale/implicit/owner checks were retained. See TEST_REPORT.md.
gates.rationale: Narrow package imports replaced broad namespace imports. This removed all 59 potential implicit-import findings, including four local-binding misattributions that disappeared when their names were no longer imported broadly. Any new non-public qualified name now fails the regression gate.

gates.title: Pinned JET analysis on concrete entrypoints
gates.message: A temporary environment pinned to JET 0.11.5 analyzed concrete mesh, excitation, dense assembly, far-field, Q, and workflow entrypoints and reported zero errors on 2026-08-25. A four-thread bounds-checked ACA construction also verified that its workspace length equals the maximum assembled low-rank block rank.
